items.name: Extremely Mini-sota 2024
items.information: ### There is no 3x3 at this competition and it is held on a *Monday Evening* **[Click here for other upcoming Minnesota competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=minnesota&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list)** | | | -------- | We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions. | | | -------- | Only 1 guest per competitor is allowed to enter the room to ensure we have enough space. The number of rounds and advancement conditions are subject to change based on the competitor count. Competitors will be informed of any changes.
